Replay

Recovery-backup status

2 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓

room_backup_status(&room) returns a local observation of recovery preparation. It reads Room's clock; the overload with now_ms accepts a time in that same clock domain and is otherwise read-only. Neither form renews, retires or changes the Lease, requests a transfer, elects a host or authorizes a handoff.

For a current steady observation, the report includes the last accepted nominee/Point, observation epoch/revision/time, known progress, known age and configured rollback limit. Room retains that accepted observation while another RPC is pending, rather than treating the transient empty RPC reply as lost approval.

Phase Meaning
Unavailable Room or recovery has failed, or Room is not open
Connecting Registration/session entry is incomplete
Waiting_Peer No eligible nominee is known; the host also checks its actual admitted connection
Transferring A nominee exists but approval or the nominee's retained exact copy is missing
Ready A scope-valid approved Point is within the known rollback bound
Stale Known progress exceeds that bound for the approved Point
Checking Control/clock/epoch observation is no longer valid for this session
Recovering Fencing or a requested/in-progress authority transition is active

Approval must match the current accepted Lease view and session epoch. Nomination checks include enabled hosting trust and dedicated infrastructure policy. A host also checks seat, token binding, incarnation and connection generation/liveness. The nominee needs its retained exact prepared Point. Other clients can report the coordinator's observation without holding authority-only checkpoint bytes.

Age is the nonnegative difference between the approved tick and the greater of coordinator-known progress and locally observed authoritative progress. It is a known/conservative age, not proof of unreported work or remote process liveness. Interpret age only for Ready/Stale, and do not treat zero metadata in connecting, checking, unavailable or recovering states as a valid zero-age backup. A Point exactly at the rollback limit remains Ready; one tick beyond is Stale. Expired/backward/invalid clock observations cannot produce Ready.

room_backup_message(status) supplies compact UI text, including “Recovery backup confirmed” rather than promising future recovery availability. room_recovery_message also retains disclosure of a completed host change or published restore, while still distinguishing a current pending/stale/checking backup. A previous successful restore is not evidence of a fresh backup now.

Planned handoff keeps its existing API and eligibility checks; it can prepare a new final checkpoint. The readiness report is not a replacement for that protocol or a permanent guarantee against subsequent failures. Tests cover policy/clock edges and a live delayed-preparation, refresh, handoff and departing-peer scenario.
